name: Blood coagulation with FXII contact activation and fibrinolysis
rationale: All members concern plasma clot formation and dissolution; unlike the VWF and F8/F9-defect confusables, this theme carries the FXII/kallikrein contact system (hereditary angioedema, amyloid-induced FXII activation) and plasminogen/fibrinolysis regulation.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover developmental shaping of the eye (optic cup, iris, eyelid, optic nerve, retina layers) and differentiation of retinal neurons, without the phototransduction/retinoid, lens/cornea or vascular content of the confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing and calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members share mitochondrial protein processing/turnover, and uniquely include SMDT1 processing and regulation of mitochondrial calcium import, which separates it from the protein-import and cristae confusables.

name: Short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisomal alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members concern short/medium-chain fatty acid and acyl-CoA turnover plus peroxisomal phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl beta-oxidation, which distinguishes it from mitochondrial beta-oxidation/ketone and very-long-chain confusables.

qualifier: FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK kinase fusions
rationale: All members are cancer-associated fusions, amplifications or mutants of FGFR, PDGFR and ALK-family kinases, distinct from the KIT/TKI-resistance, EGFR/ERBB2 and FLT3 confusables.

name: Ischemic oxygen deprivation and hydrogen sulfide response
rationale: The three members concern tissue oxygen supply and ischemia together with the gasotransmitter H2S, not the peroxide/nitrosative stress, KATP channel or apoptosis content of the confusables.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine synthase remethylation
rationale: Members cover folate/pterin and tetrahydrofolate interconversion and MTR/MTRR-dependent methionine synthesis, whereas confusables centre on SAM/methionine salvage or folate response.

name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition with maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: All members describe the oocyte-to-embryo handover (zygotic genome activation, cleavage, pronuclear reprogramming) with maternal mRNA deadenylation and decay, unlike the germline/piRNA confusables.

name: Nucleolar pre-rRNA processing and snoRNA-guided rRNA methylation
rationale: Members cover pre-rRNA cleavage and Pol I rRNA transcription plus box C/D snoRNP assembly and rRNA methylation, which the ribosome-assembly and exosome confusables lack.

name: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation
rationale: Every member concerns chromosome condensation in prophase/prometaphase of mitosis or meiosis, distinct from the cohesion, centromeric chromatin and meiotic segregation confusables.

name: G2/M transition control and p53-DREAM cell-cycle gene repression
rationale: Members share G2 phase progression and checkpoint control (Cyclin B:CDK1, PLK, MASTL, Chk1/2) together with p53- and DREAM-mediated repression of cell-cycle genes, unlike APC/C, G1/S or generic cell-cycle confusables.

core: Reactive carbonyl detoxification and protein repair
name: Reactive oxygen and carbonyl detoxification with protein repair
rationale: Members cover methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein repair, and uniquely ROS detoxification and cell redox homeostasis, which all confusables lack.

name: Proximal TCR signaling restrained by CTLA4 and BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: Members concern CD3/zeta phosphorylation and ZAP-70 recruitment with its negative regulation by CTLA4/BTLA, distinguishing it from CD28 costimulation, BCR and downstream TCR confusables.

name: snRNP biogenesis and histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap hypermethylation and transport, and stem-loop histone mRNA processing, whereas confusables centre on polyadenylation and mRNA export.

name: Cytosolic ribosomal subunit joining and peptide chain elongation
rationale: All four members are ribosomal-subunit-centred steps of translation (40S pool, 43S formation, 60S joining, elongation), distinct from initiation-factor, termination/NMD and rRNA-processing confusables.

name: Vitamin D metabolism and cytochrome P450 vitamin-hydroxylase defects
rationale: Members concern vitamin D activation/inactivation and CYP27B1/CYP24A1/CYP26 hydroxylase disorders, lacking the phosphate, bone mineralization and vitamin K content of confusables.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 and Cdh1 control of mitotic exit
rationale: All members describe APC/C activation, substrate degradation and Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching during mitotic exit, unlike the Emi1, spindle checkpoint and PLK confusables.

name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine growth-factor/TNF-induced AP-1 immediate-early programs with ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability, separating it from FOSL target, translational silencing and stress-granule confusables.

name: Kainate and AMPA receptor signaling with Gbeta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover AMPA/kainate receptor activation and excitotoxicity plus GIRK and Ca2+ channel inhibition by Gbeta-gamma, which the presynaptic-release, nicotinic and receptor-trafficking confusables lack.

qualifier: protection, recombination inhibition and C-strand replication
name: Telomere protection, recombination control and C-strand replication
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, suppression of telomeric recombination (ATRX/DAXX) and C-strand fill-in synthesis, as opposed to the telomerase-extension and general DNA repair confusables.

name: Ectodermal placode formation and epithelial lumen cavitation
rationale: The three members concern early ectodermal differentiation, hair placode induction and lumen cavitation, rather than the keratinocyte, hair cycle or salivary branching confusables.

name: Plus-end organelle and mitochondrial transport with endolysosome size control
rationale: Members share microtubule-directed positioning of organelles, notably mitochondria and synaptic vesicles, plus endosome/lysosome size control, unlike the dense-core-vesicle, autophagy-fusion and tubulin-modification confusables.

core: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
qualifier: N-glycan processing and lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism
name: Hexosamine, sialic acid, N-glycan and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism, N-glycan processing and lysosomal ganglioside/oligosaccharide catabolism, distinct from GPI/glycolipid synthesis, O-glycan/nucleotide-sugar transport and mucopolysaccharidosis confusables.

qualifier: Golgi positioning, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi positioning, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi localization, vesicle budding, constitutive secretion and endosome tubulation, without the Rab/ARF regulation, Golgi disassembly or recycling content of confusables.

core: Regulation of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
name: CDC42-IQGAP regulation of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
rationale: Members cover positive and negative control of lamellipodia, pseudopodia, focal adhesion and integrin signaling, uniquely anchored by the CDC42 GTPase cycle and IQGAP activation.
